utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what’s the next thing you need?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Leo. I could really use help sorting the donated tools and loading the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can sort the tools first, then help load the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d like to know the timing and where to drop things off first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right — can you confirm the timing and the drop-off spot before we set anything up?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes — please confirm the timing and the exact drop-off spot, and I’ll plan around that.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I must’ve missed the details; what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, just whatever’s easy for you—tools, spare screws, maybe some tape. I’m still sorting the list, honestly.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, I can grab some tape and a small screwdriver if I’ve got one lying around. Just let me know if the list gets updated.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and remind folks to bring any tools they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I’ll mention it while I’m out running errands too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks — I’ll keep it going and make sure folks hear about it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive coming along?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Dane — it’s coming along nicely. I’ve got a few tools set aside if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Gus — that’s really helpful. I’ll swing by and see what I can use.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: I’ll check my schedule and bring what I can by Friday. If you want, I can also help sort the donations when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That would be amazing, Eli—thank you. I’ll spread the word and have everything ready for Friday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Quinn. I’ll stick to Friday and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for the repair drive, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, we’re still on for it — just bring your gloves, a water bottle, and any basic tools you’ve got. I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll bring my gloves, a water bottle, and a few basic tools. What time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help get the repair drive moving—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you check whether the repair drive is still at the community shed or if someone moved it? I’m trying to keep track of where everything is.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can check the community shed and ask around to see if anyone moved it. I’ll let you know as soon as I find out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m in — I can help with the repair drive and I’ll keep track of what I’ve promised.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Mara — thank you. I’ll keep your name on the list and check in as the repair drive comes together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — thanks, Rosa. Let me know what you need me to do first, and I’ll follow through.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies for the repair drive. Just tell me what we’re short on, and I’ll help round it up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll take a quick look and let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Bo — I’ll be here when you’ve got the list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I’m keeping an ear out for the repair drive news. If I spot anything, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Tess — I’d appreciate that. I’ll keep listening too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything about the repair drive. Hopefully we get some good news soon!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t checked the repair drive details yet, so let me make sure I’ve got it right before I say more. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I can check after school and let you know. If you find the details first, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. I’ll check for the details too, and send them your way if I find anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can grab the supplies list and check who’s already signed up. Just tell me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can take the flyer and the signup board. If you check the list, I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help spread the word about the repair drive and remind folks about the plan.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be amazing, Vik — thanks! I’ll send you the details so you can share them around.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, send them over and I’ll keep sharing the details with folks around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might’ve missed the update, but I’m interested; what’s the plan?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s pretty simple: folks can drop off any small appliances or tools that need fixing, and we’ll sort them by what can be repaired. I can send you the details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, please send me the details — I’d like to check what I can bring by.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is getting organized soon. If you need a hand, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rey — I appreciate that. I’ve got a few tools ready, and I’ll let you know if we need another set of hands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course—just give me a shout if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll keep the repair drive organized and make sure folks know what’s needed and when. If you’ve got items to add, I’m ready to jot them down.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye out and send over any items I spot, along with where they’re coming from.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — send them my way and I’ll keep the list updated so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m a little worried about the timing and who’s bringing what. Do we have the schedule and a clear list of supplies yet?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Not quite yet, but I’m putting it together now — I’ll send the schedule and supply list over soon. If you can help, I’d love for you to join in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, that helps — I’ll wait for the schedule and list before I commit to anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, that’s still happening — let me double-check the details before we go ahead.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — can you confirm the time and where we’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help, Dane—let’s keep it simple and clear. Tell me what needs fixing, and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Eli — I’m a bit late, but the porch light and the loose fence gate are the main things that need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Got it — porch light and fence gate, nice and simple. I’ll take them one at a time and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is starting up soon—what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can use a few extra boxes of screws and some sturdy tape for the repair drive. If you’ve got either, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can check around for both and bring them by if I find them. If you think of anything else, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I meant to bring my tools, but I think I left them by the door again. What do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries — can you help sort the tools and check the sign-up list? That’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I can sort the tools and take a look at the sign-up list. If I wander off looking for my own wrench, just poke me and I’ll come back.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off, so just let me know when the repair drive is happening.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye — I’ll send the repair drive time as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, Leo — just send it over when you know, and I’ll work around the school schedule.
